paragraphs: It begins with an abandoned garden.

In the 1970s, Henri Marceau fell in love with a secret estate on the heights of the French Riviera. He planted frangipani, banana trees, hibiscus. He built ten white wooden houses facing the sea. He called it Caléa · the hidden paradise.
For forty years, families from around the world came here to leave behind their luggage and their urgency.
Then came Théo. The son. The heir. The one who could have sold it all. He chose to dream differently.
With the vision of a new generation and a deep respect for what his father had planted, Théo reimagined Caléa. Same soul. New breath.

features: Caléa Spa · rituals inspired by tropical and Provençal traditions.

bungalowsIntro.title: Ten worlds. Ten ways to disappear.
bungalowsIntro.subtitle: Each bungalow is a destination of its own.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW TIARE
bungalows.description: The most intimate. Nestled beneath a century-old frangipani, it awakens every sense at dawn. Private terrace, outdoor stone shower, canopy bed draped in white linen.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW AZUR
bungalows.description: Facing the sea. The Mediterranean blue becomes your horizon from bed. Heated private pool, suspended terrace, in-room breakfast included.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW SELVA
bungalows.description: Immersed in tropical vegetation. The Provençal jungle wraps around you. Private hammam, Japanese wooden bath, light filtered through leaves all day long.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW SOLANDRA
bungalows.description: The largest. Designed for families who refuse to choose between space and refinement. Two bedrooms, open garden lounge, private pool, summer kitchen.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW ALBA
bungalows.description: The dawn bungalow. East-facing, it catches the very first light of day. Perfect for early risers and lovers of golden morning silence.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW CORAIL
bungalows.description: Coral and white tones. A warm and enveloping atmosphere. Direct garden access, freestanding white marble bathtub, terrace with suspended daybed.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW NOHEA
bungalows.description: "Graceful" in Hawaiian. The most refined. Clean lines, raw natural materials, absolute silence. For those who know that true luxury is the absence of excess.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW MISTRAL
bungalows.description: The wildest. Perched at the edge of the estate, it offers open views of the garrigue and the sea. Open architecture, bamboo pergola, a constant warm breeze.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW LOTUS
bungalows.description: Our signature bungalow. A private pool surrounded by lotus flowers, a terrace floating above the water, a bed facing the starlit sky. The Caléa experience in its purest form.

bungalows.name: LE BUNGALOW HENRI
bungalows.description: A tribute to the founder. The original bungalow, lovingly restored by Théo. Vintage furniture, archive photographs on the walls, soul intact. To sleep here is to sleep inside history.

items.title: Your Personal Oasis
items.description: After a day of exploring under the Mediterranean sun, our Spa is the perfect place to unwind and recharge – featuring soothing treatments for body and mind.
items.imageOverlaySub: Gently bubbling warm water to let your soul unwind.

items.title: Marine Escape
items.description: Get on board our private sailboat to explore inaccessible coves and the secret islands of the French Riviera.
items.imageOverlaySub: Glide over the water off the coastline.

items.title: Provençal Flavors
items.description: Learn the secrets of sunny cuisine during an exclusive workshop with our Michelin-starred Chef, and taste your creations facing the sea.
items.imageOverlaySub: Passion for taste and local products.

items.title: Sunrise Awakening
items.description: Find perfect balance facing the horizon. Our private yoga classes at dusk or dawn revive every sense.
items.imageOverlaySub: Ultimate harmony between breath and waves.
